ValidationRule.description: If Marketing RT, and Campaign Level = Child: Delivery Mechanism Type, then Delivery Mechanism Type is required
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( Campaign_Level__c , "Child: Delivery Mechanism Type"), ISPICKVAL( Delivery_Mechanism_Type__c , ""), RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Marketing_Record_Type')
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Delivery Mechanism Type must have a value when Campaign Level is "Child: Delivery Mechanism Type"
